top_signals.title: Oil Slumps, US Futures Rise on Iran Talks Optimism: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Oil dropped, US equity futures rose and the dollar slipped after President Donald Trump said fresh US-Iran talks would begin Monday, boosting optimism the two sides could reach a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
